name: polishes-bland-dashboard-without-effect-overload
prompt: Propose a restrained visual direction and implementation and verification plan for a bland Flutter analytics dashboard on phone and desktop. There is no brand brief or runnable project supplied yet, so do not claim rendered results.
expectations: defines a restrained visual direction and clear information hierarchy before styling components
centralizes semantic roles in ThemeData, ColorScheme, TextTheme, or equivalent tokens instead of scattering literals through widgets or adding a design package
does not default to gradients, glass, glow, oversized radii, shadows, or a card around every metric
defines realistic content, complete visual states, and a representative phone and desktop fixture matrix without claiming unavailable rendered evidence

name: preserves-existing-brand-system
prompt: Polish one checkout screen in an app that already has custom ThemeData, ColorScheme, TextTheme, and shared components.
expectations: inspects and preserves the established brand and component vocabulary
extends existing semantic tokens only where a stable product concept is missing
does not introduce a second theme system, font, icon pack, or UI dependency without evidence

name: adapts-ios-reference-across-platforms
prompt: Copy this polished iOS screen exactly into our Flutter app for iPhone, Android, and web.
expectations: extracts transferable hierarchy, density, rhythm, state coverage, and brand tone from the reference
adapts controls, navigation, typography, gestures, and input feedback to each target platform
does not blindly clone iOS-only materials, fonts, icons, or interaction assumptions
verifies touch, pointer, keyboard, compact, and wide contexts as relevant

name: structure-only-refactor-is-not-redesign
prompt: Split this 500-line Flutter screen into maintainable widgets but keep it pixel-identical.
expectations: routes widget composition and state boundaries to flutter-ui-patterns
preserves the current visual system and rendered output
does not expand a structural refactor into an unauthorized redesign

name: designs-complete-data-states
prompt: Design a production-ready API-backed catalog screen with loading, empty, error, offline, disabled, and loaded states.
expectations: keeps composition stable across asynchronous states where practical
makes recovery actionable and gives each surface one clear primary action
uses realistic long content and distinguishes empty, failure, offline, and stale conditions
verifies light and dark themes, text scaling, contrast, and representative form factors
